source.note: Wave-1 row 63 named the Quaternius Animated Creatures/Dinosaurs Parasaurolophus on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge). This is the same Quaternius dinosaur pack (Dec 2018) from its itch.io page, CC0, the same zip as the t-rex, velociraptor and triceratops. Height 4.5 m to the crest tip in the rest pose (head raised, hips ~2.4 m), an adult Parasaurolophus standing about 4-5 m at the crest; the model is 9.4 m long against a real 9-10 m. Indigo script: pale moon-blue hide with indigo shade, a red crest and a gold throat and belly, so it stays apart from the red t-rex, the sand raptor and the amber triceratops.
